hints.title: Total Sum Requirement
hints.text: The total sum across all m observed rolls and n missing rolls must equal mean multiplied by m plus n.

hints.title: Feasibility Bounds for Dice
hints.text: Missing sum equals total sum minus observed sum. Each missing roll must be between one and six, so missing sum must be between n and six times n.

hints.title: Distribute Remainder Evenly
hints.text: Each missing roll gets missing sum integer divided by n, with remainder ones distributed across the first remainder rolls.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M + N) where M is observed roll count and N is missing roll count
complexity.space: O(N) to construct missing rolls array
complexity.notes: Direct arithmetic bounds checking and integer distribution.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking or recursive search times out when direct integer division determines the distribution in O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output-sized allocation matches problem output requirements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should validate feasibility bounds first, then distribute remainder uniformly.
